programme.title: Tamanna
programme.desc: Tikku, a eunuch, decides to raise Tamanna, an abandoned girl, at her home. However, Tamanna decides to go in search of her real family and learn the reason for her abandonment.

programme.title: Issaq
programme.desc: In the kaleidoscopic cityscapes of Banaras, a soul-stirring Romeo-and-Juliet-esque romance kindles between two young individuals from rival mafia families.

programme.title: Kabzaa
programme.desc: Ravi works for Veljibhai Soda, a gangster, and does illegal work for him. Once, he is asked to vacate Ali from his property, but he gets inspired by his ideals and decides to change his ways.

programme.title: Sheshnaag
programme.desc: Pritam and Banu, two shape-shifting snakes in human form, seek protection from a young man when an evil priest tries to hunt them down and use them in a ritual for wealth and immortality.

programme.title: Bol Radha Bol
programme.desc: While Kishen enjoys village life and romance with Radha, a sinister doppelgänger plots. Upon returning home, he'll discover his identity and life stolen by this malevolent impostor.

programme.title: Naseeb Apna Apna
programme.desc: A naive village girl marries the son of a domineering man. However, upon her arrival at his house in the city, she finds out that he is already married.

programme.title: Khoon Bhari Maang
programme.desc: Widowed Aarti falls prey to Sanjay's vicious plan of getting married to him. Later, with the help of her best friend Nandini, he drowns Aarti and seizes her wealth, but she survives and seeks revenge.

programme.title: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
programme.desc: Star-crossed lovers connect, only to be torn apart by familial obligations. They part ways reluctantly, clinging to the dream of a future reunion.

programme.title: Nafrat Ki Aandhi
programme.desc: Ravi Kapoor, a police officer and Sonu Dada, a former criminal, join hands together to take down a notorious gangster, Chandi Das.

programme.title: Barsaat
programme.desc: Badal, a simple village boy, falls for his classmate Tina. However, Tina's father does not approve of their relationship and conspires to separate them.

programme.title: Anari No. 1
programme.desc: Raja, a waiter, and his girlfriend, Sapna, hatch a plan to kidnap Rahul, a rich man who is Raja's lookalike. But things go awry when Raja gets trapped in his own plan.

programme.title: Daanveer
programme.desc: Vijay, an orphan, is tasked with raising his siblings, Vishal and Sudha. Later, Sudha is disowned by her in-laws and Vishal falls for the enemy's daughter, but Vijay comes to their rescue.

programme.title: Aitraaz
programme.desc: When a company chairman's trophy wife stirs up a storm in a happily married employee's life, the tumultuous winds drag all of them into an intense courtroom showdown.

programme.title: Judaai
programme.desc: Shashikant and Gauri get married in honour of his late father's will. But, marital problems soon arise when Gauri suspects him of having an affair, leading to a chain of misunderstandings.

programme.title: Shaan
programme.desc: After their cop brother dies at the hands of a ruthless gangster, Vijay and Ravi are determined to find the gangster and take their revenge.

programme.title: Nagina
programme.desc: Rajiv and Rajni lead a happy married life in their palatial home. However, things take a turn when Bhairon Nath informs her mother-in-law that Rajni is a shape-shifting snake.

programme.title: Kohram
programme.desc: Colonel Balbir Singh Sodhi assumes a disguise to unveil the true colours of Veer Bhadra Singh, a corrupt minister. Soon, Major Ajit teams up with him to execute the mission.
